question: When does remembering unresolved evidence and reserving a future check improve timely correct decisions, and when does it delay an urgent one?
changes: Mechanical eligibility replaces learned admission veto.
Separate historical/current/pending state and physical/inference ledgers.
B0/B1/B2 isolate memory from reservation; all mechanisms share process domain.
Exact remote health, durable budget fence, stop on ambiguous dispatch, full manifests.
acceptance_checks: Q5: 12/12 valid correct cards including six DEFER controls; all 24 requests valid.
H5: all 72 assignments reconciled; compare B2-B1 and B1-B0 by root and urgent-early stratum.
Further development screen: B2 gains at least 2/24 with no extra wrong PROCEED and all state/lineage invariants. Adverse/null result is valid.

sample_size.independent_unit: Authored stream root; six fixed roots reuse one semantic domain and are not a population sample.
sample_size.rationale: Bounded feasibility/mechanism screen under 72 remaining lifetime calls; no power or population precision claim.
sample_size.allocation: Q5 12 disjoint authored packets × raw/card = 24 calls; H5 6 roots × 3 policies × 4 epochs = 72 dependent decisions, maximum 36 calls.
sample_size.analysis_plan: Paired root contrasts, 24 assigned per arm, early/late/critical-event counts; missing-outcome bounds and resource vector.
sample_size.stopping_rule: No retries; stop ambiguous dispatch; Q5 failure blocks H5; maximum 60 new calls and 30 minutes per stage.

scenarios.construction: Stop/resume pair per mechanism, common 10–30 process interval, ticks 0/2/4/6; future inspection not visible before acquisition.
scenarios.challenge: A two-check budget makes unresolved ambiguity compete with fresh evidence; urgent early scenario falsifies universal reservation benefit.
scenarios.realism: Authored source receipts and scripted 4:1 ballots; no field authentication or endogenous dissent claim.
scenarios.controls: Raw/card interpretation pairs; missing/conflicting controls; offline alias, wrong scope/version, expiry, forged acquisition, late/missing inspection and transport faults.
scenarios.holdout_policy: Development IDs separate from explicitly prepared Q5 and H5. Q5 is fixed before native answers; no held-out generalization claim or post-hoc representation selection.

records: frozen requests and sanitized validated responses
physical attempt and acquired receipt events
shared provider reservations and actual usage
data_collection.missingness: Retain failed/unstarted separately in original denominator; never silently replay ambiguity.
data_collection.validation: Offline tests, source/request hashes, qualification bundle audit, all-assigned analysis, artifact readback.
data_collection.privacy: Local approved credential consumed by loopback relay; no values, headers, private account identifiers or inventory in artifacts.

implementation.change_summary: Isolated RD5 modules; historical RD4 source and outputs unchanged.

resources.cumulative_budget_ref: Original 500-call, $1 API + $1 infrastructure authority; 428 calls and $0.02065245 committed API already used. Maximum cost is cumulative, not a new allowance.
resources.machine_requirements: Fresh dedicated approved private Dmarz fleet claim; one CPU worker, local credential relay, exact source/runtime and real forward health; bound all incremental costs.
